Show Loves Only You (Casual)
So this time too... before I knew it, I felt the exact same way.

...Yeah, it's truly wonderful.
Being able to play a part in spreading love further and further.

Without the slightest hint of reluctance,
she readily agreed to every single request.

Please! Could you make a review video for the product?
Your review would be reliable, and I think it would be super helpful to everyone!

Aha. I'm so happy, yay! I want to keep sharing
so many more things with you, Trainer.

Something like a "special kind of love" that matches her and the fans...
Isn't that what's really needed here?

Being trusted and able to help someone out...
If the people who receive this love go on to spread it even further...
...Helpful...?

Really? I got a few comments saying that too, but...
Hearing it from you, Trainer, makes everyone's words feel even closer.

Ehehe. Perhaps... it's because I always hoped that once I found
a Trainer to take charge of me, we'd be like this.

I've gotta live up to their expectations.
Once the items arrive, I'll test them thoroughly, and look for reference books too—

Rather than behind my back, standing right beside me...
I'm sure that way, I can convey so much more to you.

Right? I'd love to recommend them, but... just in case,
let's keep them as candidates and introduce them in stages so people can read them step-by-step—

How should I put it... it feels just like
training for a race, I guess.

Not bad as weights, but... is the design a bit too plain?
Even if it's just for training, if people are going to see it, I'd want to be particular about that.

"When I went to buy the recommended book, there was only one copy left!
Barely managed to grab it, but I wonder when the next restock is~"

Thanks to you, everything went super smoothly.
Since I inevitably see things through an Umamusume's eyes—
Loves Only You's words sounded like profound trust.

Really? I got a few comments saying that too, but...
Hearing it from you, Trainer, makes everyone's words feel even closer.

Rather than behind my back, standing right beside me...
I'm sure that way, I can convey so much more to you.

When you catch the things I overlook, Trainer,
it leads to whole new discoveries. Thank you!

"The review was as detailed and easy to understand as always...
Now I'm feeling motivated all over again!"

I have my own recommendations, of course, but I really wanted to display books
curated by an Umamusume with broad perspectives, like you, Loves Only You!
...Hey, what about you?

In other words... Even though you've been supporting me,
it's felt like we're comrades heading toward the same goal together.

Thanks to you, everything went super smoothly.
I tend to see things strictly from an Umamusume's perspective, so—

Even with the extended deadline, it would surely be tough for
Loves Only You to handle alone. So—
A total success, Trainer-chan♡

I return her beaming smile with one of my own. ...Yet, I don't feel content.
Because as her Trainer—

However, I don't know how to put that into action.
As before, I still haven't found an answer I can be satisfied with.

Recalling our exchange from earlier today, I ponder.
If I am to truly live up to her trust—just this isn't enough.
Are you sure? Thank you, Trainer-chan!

Not like you're supporting me from behind,
but standing right beside me, holding hands...
Are you sure? Thank you, Trainer-kun!

Fufu, I'm so happy to hear that's how you see me!
I'll pick out a few and let you know.

We spend so much time together, right? And whenever
either of us has a problem, we talk it over and work together to solve it.

Aha, I'm so glad and relieved! I want to keep
sharing so many more things with you, Trainer-kun.
...Hey, what about you?

The data sent without any issues...
Now all we have to do is wait for them to hit the shelves♪
A total success, Trainer-kun♡

When you notice things I couldn't see, Trainer-chan,
it leads to new discoveries for me. Thank you!
Well, you see...—Oh. That's right.

My, I'm honored! If I can be of any help, I'd gladly do it.
Let's discuss the details via email♪

In that case, let's try out all sorts of things together!
That'll be way better than just doing it on my own.

When we're lost or when we hit a wall... I want us to be the kind of
partners who don't hesitate to take each other by the hand!

Other girls are discussing the items they're holding.
Loves Only You firmly lived up to the store's trust in her.
When I think of it that way, it makes me really happy.

A day off.
I came shopping with Loves Only You, but—

“I bought that product you recommended right away, and...
it was amazing! I noticed the results almost immediately.”

We'd like to set up a special corner for people who want to start exercising.
If it's okay with you, could you recommend some books for it?

We'll be getting a variety of new products in soon.
Mainly training gear, but...

How about that book?
I think the explanations in it are quite easy to understand.

Perhaps sensing something off in what I said,
Loves Only You tilts her head slightly.

Even after that, Loves Only You continued to be asked
for product reviews wherever she went.

I'm sorry. I wasn't quite sure how to phrase it,
so I got a little tongue-tied, but...

“When we're lost or when we hit a wall... I want us to be the kind of
partners who don't hesitate to take each other by the hand!”

Fufu! So many people called out to us...
It really turned into a wonderful day.

Fufu. The shop staff were happy, and
everyone who picked up the products was smiling...

Phew! We did it.
Great work, Trainer-chan♡

Phew! We did it.
Great work, Trainer-kun♡

Yeah. It doesn't chafe against the skin even when worn directly on the ankle, so it's not bad.
Though it's a bit thick, so it might make you sweat easily.
